description: Before the 20:30 sleep window a cold bedroom gets no offset (the primary sensor decides). Entering the window starts from zero and evaluates fresh; the offset is held through the night; at 06:30 the wake band is written with NO offset and the loop stays silent although the bedroom is still cold.

events.note: Bedroom already cold (primary sensor still decides before 20:30).
Bedtime: entering the remote context starts from no offset.
Bedroom reports again (every 90 min: the sensor stays fresh through the night).
Wake time: the sleep window ends; the wake band is written.
Bedroom still cold but it is no longer the comfort sensor: no offset.

assertions.reason: BEFORE the sleep window the primary sensor decides: a cold bedroom gets no offset (the 68 F comfort target is written as is).
ENTRY: the sleep window begins at zero offset, even though the bedroom is already cold.
...and is evaluated fresh: the first step.
Held at the cap all night (reports every 90 min keep the sensor fresh).
EXIT: the wake band is written with NO offset (plain 68 F), not 72 F or the cap.
After the window ends the bedroom is no longer the comfort sensor: no further offset writes, though it is still cold.

notes: Three-exercise protocol (CLAUDE.md section 10), Issue #1194 increment (e). Tier A: the real ClimateAdvisorCoordinator + AutomationEngine under FakeHass/FakeScheduler (use_coordinator=true, so the sleep-sensor listener and the 1-minute timer are real); every assertion is track=integration for that reason and is evaluated, not skipped.

(a) Effectiveness: scratch-copy mutation run of this scenario against the production code (worktree untouched). It FAILS when M01: the whole offset deleted (the write path adds 0 and the check is a no-op); M02: the +4 F cap removed; M10: the offset not forgotten when the remote context ends. Passes unmutated.

(b) Docs <-> production alignment: docs/08-COMPUTATION-REFERENCE.md 'Remote-sensor outer loop on the thermostat setpoint (Issue #1194, increment a)': 'Scope and keying', the before/after table row 'Sleep window ends'. Matches production at 0.8.44; increment (c) (context transitions) refines the same behaviour and must keep this scenario true.
(c) Occupant outcome if this regressed: The wake-up temperature must be the occupant's morning comfort target, not +4 F of overnight compensation.

verdict.summary: Sleep-window entry starts at zero; exit leaves no offset.
verdict.observed_behavior: 68 F before the window, 66 F at 20:30, 68 F at 20:31; wake 68 F at 06:30; nothing afterwards.
verdict.expected_behavior: Offset belongs to the remote context only (keyed on indoor_temp provenance).
